pylons_vi: 2 tháp chữ H hai cột đứng, dầm ngang ở khoảng 2/3 chiều cao trên mặt cầu, giằng chân sát mặt nước; dây neo yên ngựa; cao 155 m tính từ móng
pylons_en: 2 H pylons with two vertical legs, a crossbeam at ≈2/3 of the height above deck and a tie beam at the waterline; stays over saddles; 155 m from the foundations

model3d.notes: Spans 187.25 + 375 + 187.25 m (VECC). Two PC edge box girders 3 m deep, 24.85 m apart, 30.35 m overall (21.75 m = roadway). 155 m pylons from foundations (VECC; 135 m = Phước Khánh). H legs at ±18.4 m just outside the deck, upper beam at ≈2/3 of the above-deck height, tie beam at the waterline, no beam under the deck (photos 2025). 17 stay pairs per pylon side, 68 cables over saddles, 58.7–197.6 m. Deck ≈60 m above water (55 m clearance).

pylon_custom.description: H pylon: two vertical, slightly tapered rectangular legs just outside the 30.35 m deck, one crossbeam at about 2/3 of the height above deck, a deep tie beam linking the feet just above the waterline, no crossbeam under the deck; stays pass over saddles in the upper legs.

notes: Round 7 (research/model-review/brief-r7-binh-khanh.md): photos 2025 (PLO 12/2025, VTC 8/2025, Sài Gòn Times 2/2025 and 7/2025) show the upper beam at ≈2/3 height and the tie beam at the water; no auxiliary piers.
